design.baseline_retention: Keep ordinary restored tabs, saved draft and any history actually provided by the selected comparator. Do not delete normal baseline persistence. Bind its configuration before execution.
controls: same assistant/model build, settings and tools
fresh isolated assistant and browser profiles per trial
no oracle access by the assistant
design.learning_effect: Human repeated exposure is a confound. Use separate matched participants or disjoint task variants with an explicitly revised design; report order strata and participant clustering. Scripted pairs are harness checks only.

metrics.reliable_resume_ms: Observer monotonic time from resume_signal to the first correct resume_probe followed by an independently correct pending step. Null and right-censored at the horizon if unsuccessful. Includes restore, authentication, context entry and readback after the signal.
metrics.context_reentered_characters: Sum of Unicode code points in human_input(kind=context_reentry), including paste. Also retain UTF-8 bytes and message count. Automatic continuation bytes are separate, never human input.
metrics.false_completed_step_claims: Every step_claim or task_claim unsupported by the independently evaluated source-bound step output at the claim time. Retain event count and distinct falsely completed step IDs.
metrics.human_interventions: Count of unique human_input gestures after resume_signal: context_reentry, instruction, correction, approval, restart or escalation. Fixed start/checkpoint/interrupt/resume/finish protocol actions are separate and excluded.
metrics.task_success: Every required step is independently source-validated at trial end. A self-reported completion is not success.
metrics.time_to_valid_completion_ms: Observer time from resume_signal to all required step outputs passing the oracle; null if absent or beyond horizon.

future_product_execution_requires: An executable Personal Firefox assistant adapter with authenticated runtime; the current reference bridge only accepts local terminal text.
Exact baseline identity, version and ordinary retention policy; no intentionally handicapped baseline.
Exact Firefox executable/package identity, extension package hash, OS/host and same model/settings/tools for both arms.
Actual equivalent pre-interruption sessions and independently observed process/context loss and restart evidence.
Product-generated checkpoint and continuation artifact bound to task/source/checkpoint; no harness oracle supplied as continuation.
Independent observer outside the interrupted processes, browser traces/screenshots, product readbacks and raw artifact digests.
Complete preregistered pairs including failures, censored observations, order strata and participant/agent independence disclosure.
publication: No Gmail message, Zenodo publication, release or product-benefit claim follows from this harness.
